representative_claims.text: ARIA completed the submitted analysis. 3 findings were recorded across all modalities, of which 0 reached HIGH confidence. See the governed claim ledger below for published results.
Raw bulk chromatin read preprocessing trimmed and aligned 6 sample(s) (paired layout), retaining filtered non-mitochondrial alignments for peak calling.
CUT&TAG QC measured 4 sample(s) with mean mitochondrial fraction 0.0.
SEACR peak calling for CUT&TAG identified 30560 peaks.
CUT&TAG peak counting produced a matrix with 19229 peaks across 4 samples.
CUT&TAG DESeq2 differential binding ran 1 comparison(s) over 4 replicate samples and found 1792 differential peaks.
TF motif enrichment (JASPAR2024_CORE_vertebrates, hypergeometric) tested 879 motifs and found enriched motifs in 2 of 2 peak group(s).
Genomic annotation classified 1792 CUT&TAG differentially accessible peak(s) by feature; 681 (38%) fall in promoter regions.
Functional ORA (local_hypergeometric) of genes near CUT&TAG differentially accessible peaks found 70 enriched term(s) across 4 database(s).
